info.title: ACME Project Tracker API
info.description: Generated from backend/tracker/api/routes.py by tools/openapi.py. Log in with POST /auth/login, then send the token as a Bearer token.

servers.description: Local: the proxy started by bin/start-dev.sh

get.summary: Check the API and the database are up.

post.summary: Log in with username and password; get a 15-minute token and a refresh token.
Trade a refresh token for a new token pair.
End the session that owns this refresh token.

get.summary: Get your own account.
get.description: Any signed-in user. Allowed before the first password change.

post.summary: Change your password (required on first login); get a new token pair.
post.description: Any signed-in user. Allowed before the first password change.

get.summary: List people, with search and filters.

post.summary: Create an account; the answer shows the generated password once.

patch.summary: Change your own name or email.

get.summary: Get one person.
One person's trail; only admins get the before/after state.

patch.summary: Set a person's weekly capacity, overtime and task limit.

post.summary: Reset a person's password; the answer shows the new one once.
Archive a person (there is no delete).
Reactivate an archived person.

get.summary: List projects, with search and filters.

post.summary: Create a project.

get.summary: Get one project.

patch.summary: Change a project's details or budget.

post.summary: Archive a project (there is no delete).
Reactivate an archived project.

get.summary: Get a project's budget: planned and consumed cost against the budget.
Get a project's Deliverables and the dependencies between them.
Get a project's pull board: its tasks and who holds them.
List a project's Resources (bookings: person x hours per week).

post.summary: Book a person onto a project (a Resource).

patch.summary: Change a booking's hours or dates.

post.summary: Archive a booking (there is no delete).

get.summary: List a project's Deliverables.

post.summary: Add a Deliverable to a project.

get.summary: Get one Deliverable.

post.summary: Archive a Deliverable (there is no delete).
Reactivate an archived Deliverable.
Sign off a Deliverable (refused until its tasks and dependencies are done).
Reopen a signed-off Deliverable.
Make a Deliverable depend on another one (loops are refused).
Remove a dependency between two Deliverables.

get.summary: List a Deliverable's tasks.

post.summary: Add a task to a Deliverable.

patch.summary: Change a task's title, description, estimate or assignee.

post.summary: Move your task to To Do, In Progress or Done.
Take a Ready task from the pull board (up to your task limit).
Put your task back on the pull board.
Archive a task (there is no delete).
Reactivate an archived task.

get.summary: List the tasks assigned to you.
List the Ready tasks you can take, with how many you hold and your limit.

post.summary: Log time on your task.

get.summary: List the time you have logged.

patch.summary: Change your own time entry; it goes back to pending approval.

post.summary: Approve a time entry (never your own).
Reject a time entry (never your own).

get.summary: List the time entries waiting for your approval.
List the requests you sent or may decide.

post.summary: Send a request (new project, archive, task limit, overtime or other).

get.summary: Get one request.

post.summary: Approve a request; the change it asks for is applied at once.
Reject a request, with an optional note.

get.summary: Get the dashboard: each project's status, risk and budget, at risk first.
List the projects at risk of missing a deadline.
Get the allocation grid: people x weeks, flagged past capacity.

schema.description: Project ids separated by commas, such as 3,7: only bookings on those projects count, and people with none in the shown weeks drop out. At most 100.

get.summary: Get a timeline of your projects: their dates, Deliverables and bookings.
Run the integrity queries; every list must be empty.
List the audit log, with filters by actor, entity and date.
List your notifications.
Count your unread notifications.

post.summary: Mark all your notifications as read.
Mark one of your notifications as read.
